# Notice: Plain JS files detected

This PR either has added, modified or deleted JS files. Most likely added.

- If you used a compiler to convert TS files to JS, remove those files and reference the TS file in HTML pages (as per the README).
- If you wrote the JS file yourself, convert it to TS and follow the instructions on the README.
- If you modified JS files, please contact the person who added them in the first place and ask them to convert to TS and follow the instructions on the README.
- If you deleted JS files (and got equivalent functionality), thanks! And please disregard.
